title: dshbase plugin evidence
description: Short per-plugin evidence for the Chinese and English detail pages. A follow-up verification PR fills plugins.<slug>. An empty plugins object means every page uses the honest fallback. This file does not change catalog test badges.

plugins.description: Map of plugin slug to one evidence record. Slugs match plugins.json slug.

conclusion.description: Short English conclusion in a sentence, not a badge word and not a raw log.

conclusion_zh.description: Short Chinese conclusion. Required so the zh page does not fall back to English or to catalog boilerplate.

dshVersionRequested.description: Dist-tag that was installed. Always official @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest. The pilot report stores this as latest; the page displays @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest. A frozen rc or exact version is rejected.

dshVersionActual.description: First line of `dsh --version` after that dist-tag resolved. May itself be an rc if latest pointed at one. Not the dist-tag and not a version the catalog pinned in advance.

needs.description: English description of external accounts or services required for a level marked needs. Omit or use an empty string when nothing external is required. needs is not a failure and not Verified.

needs_zh.description: Chinese description of the same external requirement. Required when needs is set, and when any level status is needs.

status.description: pass: the level ran and succeeded. skip: not run or not applicable, including L3 web-only (a GUI plugin waiting on a browser service is skip, not fail, and not pass). fail: the level ran and did not succeed for a reason other than web-only or a missing external account. needs: an external account or service was required, so the level could not be completed. needs is not a plugin failure and not Verified.

reason.description: One short English sentence a person can read. Not a stack trace and not only the words web-only or needs-env.

example-headless.conclusion: Install and load succeeded on the dsh version resolved from @latest. The headless prompt did not call the model because no API key was configured.
example-headless.conclusion_zh: 在 @latest 解析出的 dsh 版本上，安装和加载成功。因为没有配置 API key，无头提问没有调用模型。
example-headless.needs: A DeepSeek API key for the headless model call. This run did not set one.
example-headless.needs_zh: 无头模型调用需要 DeepSeek API key。这次没有配置。

L1.reason: dsh plugin add finished in a clean profile and the package was recorded there.
L1.reason_zh: 干净 profile 里 dsh plugin add 完成，包已写入该 profile。

L2.reason: The profile booted and dump-config listed the plugin bundle.
L2.reason_zh: profile 能启动，dump-config 列出了该插件 bundle。

L3.reason: The headless prompt never called the model because DEEPSEEK_API_KEY was not set.
L3.reason_zh: 没有设置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，无头提问没有调用模型。

L4.reason: Web CDP was not run. L3 was not web-only, and a missing API key is not a browser result.
L4.reason_zh: 没有跑 Web CDP。L3 不是 web-only，缺 API key 也不是浏览器结果。

example-web-only.conclusion: Install and load succeeded. Headless L3 stopped on a GUI service, so it is web-only: not a pass and not a plugin failure. Web CDP was not run.
example-web-only.conclusion_zh: 安装和加载成功。无头 L3 停在图形界面服务上，属于 web-only：不是通过，也不是插件故障。没有跑 Web CDP。

L1.reason: dsh plugin add finished in a clean profile and the package was recorded there.
L1.reason_zh: 干净 profile 里 dsh plugin add 完成，包已写入该 profile。

L2.reason: The profile booted and dump-config listed the plugin bundle.
L2.reason_zh: profile 能启动，dump-config 列出了该插件 bundle。

L3.reason: Headless stopped while waiting for service webServer. That web-only result is not a pass and not a plugin failure.
L3.reason_zh: 无头模式停在 waiting for service webServer。这个 web-only 结果不是通过，也不是插件故障。

L4.reason: Web CDP was not run for this record, so there is no browser result to report.
L4.reason_zh: 这条记录没有跑 Web CDP，所以没有浏览器结果。
